title: Mars Rover Discoveries
snippet: NASA's Perseverance rover finds new evidence of ancient water on Mars.
full_text: The Perseverance rover has discovered rock formations that suggest a fast-flowing river once existed on Mars. This finding increases the likelihood that ancient microbial life could have been supported on the red planet. Scientists are analyzing the sedimentary layers to understand the planet's climate history.

title: Artemis Moon Mission
snippet: The Artemis II crew prepares for their journey around the Moon.
full_text: NASA's Artemis II mission will send four astronauts around the Moon, marking the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years. The mission will test the Orion spacecraft's life support systems and prepare for future lunar landings. International partnerships are key to the success of the Artemis program.

title: James Webb Telescope
snippet: James Webb Space Telescope captures stunning new images of distant galaxies.
full_text: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has peered deeper into the universe than ever before, revealing galaxies that formed just hundreds of millions of years after the Big Bang. Its infrared capabilities allow it to see through cosmic dust, providing unprecedented views of star formation and exoplanetary atmospheres.
